name: Celestial skin armor (frame)
description: only celestial skin armor, thin [[METAL_NAME]] metallic designs in her {{PRIMARY}} colour scheme with fine {{METAL}} edge lines, formed directly onto the skin as if the metal had been bound to the body by a magical spell, slightly raised and form-fitting so the contour of the body shows through; every design is open filigree with bare skin visible between its lines, and none is a cup or a plate; Breasts: on each breast one delicate design in the form of [[BREAST]], made of fine curving lines and swirls with [[ENGRAVING]], about 3 cm (one and a quarter inches) across, centred on the breast, with one tiny [[GEM_NOUN]] accent at its centre; Pelvic area: one small, form-fitting design in the form of [[HIP]], following the contour of the pelvic area, with its fine lines curving beneath the body and continuing as a narrow design over the lower back, so the rear is mostly bare skin and modestly covered; Everywhere else: the skin outside these three designs is unchanged natural skin, matte, with no metal, no metallic sheen, no paint and no tint, keeping her natural skin tone ({{SKIN}}), including the face, neck, shoulders, arms, back, stomach, hips, thighs, legs, hands and bare feet; only the two breast designs and the one pelvic design carry any metal; the natural shape, fullness and cleavage of the bust stay clearly visible, with natural anatomy and realistic skin texture
negatives: body paint over the whole body
notes: A frame, not a piece to use directly: the double-bracket gaps (metal, breast and hip shapes, engraving, gem) are filled by each hero's celestial-design file, so every sister's celestial armor shares one wording and differs only in those values.
